svg.text: Strictly qualified cycle / phase number (no missing or future points filled in)
B Post input across qualified cycles
Threshold lines and bars use observed input incl. cache + configured reserves; no estimated input values are plotted.
Solid bars are provider-reported input; hatched caps are reserved capacity, not observed usage. CSV lists both separately.
Main post curve uses first actual post; CSV also keeps selected consistent post. Missing cache buckets remain unknown.
Retained post context may accumulate across cycles. This is not an invoice or a general lossless-compression claim.
